cells.announcement: October 21, 2024 End-of-Life (EoL) announcement - Customers on SQL Sentry version 2021.1.9 or earlier should begin transitioning to the latest version of SQL Sentry.
cells.eoe: December 31, 2024 End-of-Engineering (EoE) - Service releases, bug fixes, workarounds, and service packs for SQL Sentry version 2021.1.9 or earlier will no longer actively be supported by SolarWinds.
cells.eol: July 1, 2025  End-of-Life (EoL) - SolarWinds will no longer provide technical support for SQL Sentry version 2021.1.9 or earlier.
